# monotaur_webhook_subscription (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur webhook subscription. Monotaur POSTs each event the subscription subscribes to as a CloudEvent to `url`, signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the subscription's signing key (`X-Monotaur-Webhook-Signature: v1=<hex>` over `<timestamp>.<id>.<body>`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Supply your own signing key (at least 32 bytes of UTF-8) and share it with the receiver.
resource "monotaur_webhook_subscription" "incidents" {
  url = "https://hooks.example.com/monotaur"
  event_types = [
    "com.monotaur.alarm.triggered",
    "com.monotaur.alarm.cleared",
    "com.monotaur.alarm.acknowledged",
  ]
  payload_mode = "ChangesOnly"
  signing_key  = var.webhook_signing_key
}

# Or let Monotaur generate the key: it is exposed once, at creation, as
# generated_signing_key (null after `terraform import`).
resource "monotaur_webhook_subscription" "audit" {
  url         = "https://audit.example.com/monotaur"
  event_types = ["com.monotaur.monitor.created", "com.monotaur.monitor.deleted"]
}

output "audit_signing_key" {
  value     = monotaur_webhook_subscription.audit.generated_signing_key
  sensitive = true
}

variable "webhook_signing_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) The CloudEvent types delivered to the subscription (at least one), e.g. `com.monotaur.alarm.triggered`. Legacy internal event names are not accepted.
- `url` (String) The absolute `https` URL deliveries are POSTed to (at most 2,048 characters). The server also refuses hosts blocked by its webhook egress policy (e.g. private or loopback addresses).

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether events are delivered to the subscription. Defaults to `true` on the server. Delivery sets it to `false` after too many failed deliveries in a row; when this attribute is set to `true` in the configuration the next apply enables it again, which also resets `consecutive_failure_count` and `auto_disabled_date_time`.
- `legacy_signature_enabled` (Boolean) Whether deliveries also carry the deprecated body-only `X-Monotaur-Signature-256` header, which does not protect receivers against replay. Defaults to `false` on the server for new subscriptions.
- `payload_mode` (String) How much of the resource a delivery carries: `Full` (the whole resource) or `ChangesOnly`. Defaults to `Full` on the server.
- `signing_key` (String, Sensitive) The HMAC-SHA256 signing key, at least 32 bytes of UTF-8 (e.g. the output of `openssl rand -base64 32`). When omitted on create, the server generates one and it is exposed once as `generated_signing_key`. Sensitive and write-only: the API never returns it, so the value from the configuration is kept in state, drift (e.g. a rotation outside Terraform) is not detected, and `terraform import` cannot recover it (the next apply re-sends the configured value). Changing it replaces the key at once and ends any rotation overlap. Removing it from the configuration does not change the key on the server.

### Read-Only

- `auto_disabled_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when delivery disabled the subscription after too many failures, or null (system-managed, read-only).
- `consecutive_failure_count` (Number) Deliveries in a row that ended `Failed` (system-managed, read-only).
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the subscription was created (assigned by the API).
- `generated_signing_key` (String, Sensitive) The signing key the server generated because `signing_key` was not set when the subscription was created. The API returns it only in the create response, so it is null after `terraform import`, and it is not updated by a `rotate-signing-key` call made outside Terraform. Null whenever `signing_key` is set.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the webhook subscription (assigned by the API).
- `previous_signing_key_expiry_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp until which deliveries are also signed with the key replaced by the last `rotate-signing-key` call, or null outside a rotation overlap. Changing `signing_key` clears it (system-managed, read-only).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the subscription was last updated (assigned by the API).
